subject: math
cluster: Apply geometric concepts in modeling situations
skillName: Density in Area and Volume Models

items.prompt:
Population density is:
A) Area times population
B) Population divided by area
C) Area divided by population
D) Population plus area

$12{,}000$ people in $4$ square miles gives a density of:
A) $3000$
B) $48{,}000$
C) $300$
D) $4000$

Mass density is:
A) Mass times volume
B) $\frac{\text{mass}}{\text{volume}}$
C) Volume divided by mass
D) Mass plus volume

A block of mass $90$ g and volume $30$ cubic cm has density:
A) $3$ g/cubic cm
B) $60$ g/cubic cm
C) $120$ g/cubic cm
D) $2700$ g/cubic cm

A region of density $500$ per sq mi covers $6$ sq mi. Its population is:
A) $3000$
B) $83$
C) $506$
D) $500$

Which is denser: $1000$ people in $2$ sq mi or $1200$ in $3$ sq mi?
A) They are equal
B) The first ($500$/sq mi)
C) The second ($400$/sq mi)
D) Cannot tell

A substance has density $8$ g/cubic cm and volume $5$ cubic cm. Its mass is:
A) $1.6$ g
B) $13$ g
C) $40$ g
D) $3$ g

A city of density $3000$/sq mi covers $10$ sq mi. Its population is:
A) $300$
B) $3000$
C) $30{,}000$
D) $300{,}000$
